purpose: Static reconciliation inventory only; config/channels.js remains the runtime source of truth.
preservationRules: No IDs or channel numbers were changed.
Missing numbers are recorded, not filled automatically.
streamEnabledExpression records the source-code expression; it is not proof that a stream is playable.
A streamEnv value may be a variable name or a source-classification label; do not assume every value is an environment variable.
